origin.description: The source file (a reference) or the decision that produced this table (C04 R[0]); a table without it is code

description.description: What the table checks, in the pack language

tier.description: Tier of the outcomes (C05 R[1]); default blocking when a basis is given, else advisory. Blocking needs a basis

basis.description: The acceptance contract clause a blocking check relies on (C05 R[1])

item.description: Pointer to the item identity in the subject (or in each node); copied into outcomes

location.description: Pointer to the reference URI of the item in the judged source; becomes a ground of the outcomes

catalog.description: Name of the catalog in the pack knowledge declaration (knowledge.json) that the caller binds

strict_signatures.description: Membership claims require a complete executable signature; a menu or a bare head with required arguments is not membership

commands.description: Subject locations holding command text: a string, or an array of strings, one phrase each

items.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath selecting values of the subject; only member names, indexes and wildcards are allowed

scope.description: Which phrases are checked. resolved (default): only phrases whose head resolves to an entry; first_word: phrases whose first word starts some entry, a head that does not resolve is core.catalog.not_member; all: every phrase must resolve

match.description: Normalization of command text before tokenizing; case applies to words, enum values and keywords

unicode.description: Unicode normalization form applied first; default nfc

case.description: insensitive compares lower-cased values; default sensitive

whitespace.description: trim removes leading and trailing whitespace, collapse also turns every inner whitespace run into one space; default trim

quotes.description: Single and double quotes group words into one argument; default true

required.description: A required missing location refutes core.structure.required_empty with data.missing, attributed to the subject provider; an optional missing location is listed in data.missing, never unknown

claims.description: Membership statements; a statement the catalog contradicts is core.catalog.membership_contradicted. A command exists when its words are a head, a menu, or a head followed by arguments that fit one of its signatures

select.description: Statements that a command exists or does not exist; a missing location means no statements

command.description: Pointer to the command text inside a statement

present.description: Pointer to a boolean inside a statement: true claims the command exists, false that it does not

negative.description: Negative-case handling: the interpreter still refutes, marks the outcome and applies this tier

flag.description: Pointer to a boolean in the subject that marks a negative case

expect.description: Violation codes a negative case is expected to produce; the caller compares

tier.description: Tier of the outcomes on a negative case, kept whatever tier the check declares; default advisory. Blocking needs a basis

title: catalog@1
description: Catalog table: which subject fields hold command text, which statements claim membership, tier and negative-case handling. Commands are matched by longest head against the bound catalog. Codes: core.catalog.*
